messages.content: You are a bounded pre-publication reviewer. Review only the exact diff supplied. Return one VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL followed by concrete action items. Check host-process safety, Jenkins-measured exception ancestry, live mutable-list traversal, budget safety, regressions, tests/evidence quality, and scope. Do not suggest unrelated refactors.

Review the exact local fix for the two PR #110 findings on base b785e88ba882282cdd6e788ca7be8f57c699d1f3. Requirements: longer list/map display cycles through interpolation and toString must surface a nonreflective typed StackOverflowError boundary caught by Error/Throwable but not Exception; direct-self markers remain. List each/collect/find/findAll/any/every and for-in must traverse the live VList cell by index, capture the current value before closure mutation, observe later writes and appended/null-extension slots, stop after shrinkage, retain short-circuit behavior, and budget actual visits. Do not add remove or broader collection APIs. Two Jenkins 2.568.1 cases must be tier-1 PROVEN; scorecard 224/224, 225 seals, corpus admitted197/tier3=30. Exact diff:

+// PR #110 exact-head review closure. Longer reference cycles raise the same
+// Error-ancestry StackOverflowError through interpolation and explicit display;
+// direct self-cycles retain Groovy's ordinary marker rendering.
+pipeline {
+    agent any
+    stages {
+        stage('P') {
+            steps {
+                script {
+                    def events = []
+
+                    def interpolation = [null]
+                    def interpolationMap = [back: interpolation]
+                    interpolation[0] = interpolationMap
+                    try {
+                        try {
+                            echo "value=${interpolation}"
+                            events << 'interpolation-unexpected'
+                        } catch (Exception ignored) {
+                            events << 'interpolation-overcaught'
+                        }
+                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {
+                        events << 'interpolation-escaped-exception'
+                    }
+
+                    def explicit = [null]
+                    def explicitMap = [back: explicit]
+                    explicit[0] = explicitMap
+                    try {
+                        explicit.toString()
+                        events << 'tostring-unexpected'
+                    } catch (Error ignored) {
+                        events << 'tostring-caught-error'
+                    }
+
+                    def directList = [null]
+                    directList[0] = directList
+                    def directMap = [:]
+                    directMap.self = directMap
+                    events << "direct-list=${directList}"
+                    events << "direct-map=${directMap}"
+
+                    echo "display:${events}"
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// PR #110 exact-head review closure. Jenkins CPS traversal re-reads unvisited
+// indexes and its live bound: current values stay captured, visited writes do
+// not rewrite history, and appends/null-extension become later iterations.
+pipeline {
+    agent any
+    stages {
+        stage('P') {
+            steps {
+                script {
+                    def eachXs = [1, 2]
+                    def eachSeen = []
+                    eachXs.each {
+                        eachSeen << it
+                        if (it == 1) {
+                            eachXs[0] = 8
+                            eachXs[1] = 9
+                            eachXs << 3
+                        }
+                        if (it == 9) {
+                            eachXs[0] = 7
+                        }
+                    }
+                    echo "each:${eachSeen}:${eachXs}"
+
+                    def collectXs = [1, 2]
+                    def collected = collectXs.collect {
+                        if (it == 1) {
+                            collectXs[1] = 9
+                            collectXs << 3
+                        }
+                        it * 10
+                    }
+                    echo "collect:${collected}:${collectXs}"
+
+                    def filterXs = [1, 2]
+                    def filtered = filterXs.findAll {
+                        if (it == 1) {
+                            filterXs[1] = 9
+                            filterXs << 3
+                        }
+                        it > 1
+                    }
+                    echo "findAll:${filtered}:${filterXs}"
+
+                    def forXs = [1, 2]
+                    def forSeen = []
+                    for (v in forXs) {
+                        forSeen << v
+                        if (v == 1) {
+                            forXs[1] = 9
+                            forXs[3] = 4
+                        }
+                    }
+                    echo "for:${forSeen}:${forXs}"
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
